answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond before its vote counts, and a public ledger records every attestation. A raven that rotates handles still pays a fresh bond per alias; the audit trail is hard as quartz, so peers can spot reused funding and slash it. To pose as an atlas of thousands of voters, an attacker must lock capital for each fake identity, so the cost grows linearly and is forfeited on detection.
